changes.title: Chart 3d
items: The sea chart is now a 3D night sea drawn like the game: islands as land in the water, glowing sigils on the ones you can sail to, your voyages as glowing lines; choose an island and the view glides to it

changes.title: Night won finale
items: The victory lap's sparkler races home along the ley line
Winning flares the island's sigil across the dancefloor, and each woken legend dreams of its home island

changes.title: World seed
items: Each campaign has its own world: its islands keep their shapes night after night, while the forest, scenery, animals and legends on them change each night
The sea chart shows your world's seed to share; Start over begins a new world, random or from a seed you type in (or add ?world= to the link)
